# SearchController

> Filters child items by a text query, toggling visibility and dispatching `ui-search`.

## Constructor

```ts
new SearchController(host: HTMLElement, options?: SearchOptions)
```

## Options

| Option | Type | Required | Description |
|--------|------|----------|-------------|
| `selector` | `string` | yes |  |
| `textField` | `string` | no |  |
| `disabled` | `boolean` | no |  |

## Events Dispatched

| Event | Detail |
|-------|--------|
| `ui-search` | `{ query, matchCount, total }` |

## Methods

| Method |
|--------|
| `destroy()` |
| `clear()` |

## Usage

```ts
import { SearchController } from '@nonoun/native-ui';
const ctrl = new SearchController(element, { /* options */ });
// In teardown: ctrl.destroy();
```
